prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Wide shot. A crowd seen from behind, faces not visible, stands at the foot of a hill, several arms raised pointing up at the vast ark, its whole hull smeared pitch-black under a flat plank roof, its wide wooden door open in the side and an earthen ramp down to the dust. Late afternoon, long shadows and drifting dust. Mocking and uneasy. The ark is one long, low, box-shaped wooden hull with straight sides of rough planks and flat square ends, the same low height from end to end. The ark has no mast, sail, prow, figurehead, funnel or smokestack, no smoke rising from it and no band along its waterline. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the great wooden ark, the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
